header_chirho: For God so loved the world that he gave his only begotten Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life. - John 3:16
track_a_summary_chirho: Take the v1 kernel (boots, runs hello-world ELF, has basic syscalls/VFS/scheduler) to a fully compatible Linux that boots Alpine and runs real software on real hardware.

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Each process gets its own PML4. Kernel maps shared; user maps isolated.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Kernel half shared via recursive mapping

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: On fork, mark shared user pages read-only and set COW bit in PTE metadata.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Forked child shares parent physical pages

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: On write fault to COW page, allocate new frame, copy, remap writable.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Write to COW page triggers copy

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: sys_fork/sys_clone creates child with cloned page tables using COW.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: fork() returns child PID to parent, 0 to child

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: execve loads ELF from VFS, sets up new address space, aux vector, and jumps to entry.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: execve replaces process image from filesystem ELF

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement wait queue struct. Tasks block and are woken by event producers.
read() on TTY/pipe blocks calling task via wait queue until data available.
Buffer input until newline. Handle backspace, Ctrl-C (SIGINT), Ctrl-D (EOF).
Implement essential termios ioctls for terminal configuration.
Implement getdents64 to read directory entries from VFS.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: ls-like program lists files in directory

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Return file metadata (size, mode, uid, gid, timestamps) from VFS inodes.
Create unidirectional pipe with read/write ends as file descriptors.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Write to fd[1] readable from fd[0]

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Duplicate file descriptors for shell I/O redirection.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Both fds share same file description

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Wire fork/exec/dup2/pipe together so 'cmd1 | cmd2' works.
Pass environ array to new processes via execve. Implement getenv in-kernel for PATH.
Track current working directory per process. Implement chdir/getcwd syscalls.
Implement /proc/self symlink and /proc/[pid]/{status,cmdline,maps,fd}.
Deliver signals to processes. Handle default actions (kill, stop, ignore).
Allow userspace to register custom signal handlers via rt_sigaction.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Custom SIGINT handler runs in userspace

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parent waits for child exit status. Support WNOHANG.
Implement essential fcntl operations for shell and pipe usage.
Multiplex I/O readiness on multiple fds for shell job control.
Implement setpgid/getpgid/setsid for job control.
Allow creating, writing, and deleting files in tmpfs (mkdir, creat, unlink, rmdir).
acceptance_criteria_chirho: touch/echo > file creates file in tmpfs

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Boot kernel, execve BusyBox ash, run interactive commands (ls, cat, echo, pipes).
acceptance_criteria_chirho: BusyBox ash shell starts and accepts input

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse ELF relocatable object files (.ko). Extract sections, symbols, relocations.
Maintain table of exported kernel symbols. Modules resolve against it.
Apply R_X86_64_64, R_X86_64_PC32, R_X86_64_PLT32 relocations against kernel symbols.
Allocate executable kernel memory for loaded module code and data.
Call module_init on load, module_exit on unload. Track loaded modules.
Provide C-callable printk that forwards to kernel log ring buffer.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: C module calling printk produces kernel log output

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Provide C-callable kmalloc/kfree wrappers over kernel allocator.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Module allocates and frees kernel memory via kmalloc/kfree

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Allow modules to register character devices with read/write/ioctl ops.
Allow modules to register and free interrupt handlers.
Allow modules to register PCI driver with probe/remove callbacks.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Module probe called for matching PCI device

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Safe user-kernel data transfer wrappers for module use.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Module safely copies data to/from userspace

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Provide C-callable mutex_lock/unlock and spin_lock/unlock.
Provide schedule_work/create_workqueue for deferred work in modules.
Implement syscalls for userspace insmod/rmmod.
List loaded modules with size and refcount.
Track inter-module symbol dependencies. Prevent unload if depended upon.
Parse module parameters from insmod command line (module_param macro).
acceptance_criteria_chirho: insmod hello.ko param=42 sets module parameter

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Define Rust trait-based module API as preferred alternative to C ABI shims.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Rust module loads via same mechanism

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Compile C hello-world .ko, insmod it, verify printk output, rmmod it.
Load chardev module, open /dev/chardev, read/write, unload.
Define NetDevice trait with send/receive/MAC/MTU. Loopback implements it.
Parse and construct Ethernet II frames with src/dst MAC and EtherType.
Maintain ARP cache. Send ARP requests, handle replies. Resolve IP to MAC.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: ARP reply sent for our IP

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse and construct IPv4 headers with checksum.
Simple routing table with default gateway. Longest-prefix match.
Send and receive ICMP echo request/reply. Respond to incoming pings.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: ping command sends and receives replies

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement UDP datagram send/receive with port demux.
Full TCP FSM: SYN, SYN-ACK, ESTABLISHED, FIN, TIME_WAIT. Sequence numbers.
Implement retransmit timer, sliding window, and congestion avoidance.
Implement BSD socket syscalls for AF_INET SOCK_STREAM and SOCK_DGRAM.
Implement VirtIO network device driver. TX/RX virtqueues, MAC config.
Implement epoll_create/ctl/wait with proper edge/level triggering for sockets.
Send DNS A record queries over UDP, parse responses.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Resolves hostname to IP via DNS server

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Loopback sends packets back to local stack. Assign 127.0.0.1.
Export socket state via procfs for debugging.
Implement scatter-gather I/O and ancillary data for sockets.
Implement Unix domain sockets (stream and datagram) for local IPC.
Implement SO_REUSEADDR, SO_KEEPALIVE, TCP_NODELAY, SO_RCVBUF/SO_SNDBUF.
Implement SIOCSIFADDR/SIOCGIFADDR ioctls or netlink for IP/route config.
Boot with VirtIO-net, ping external host, wget a file over HTTP.
Block device driver for VirtIO. Read/write sectors via virtqueue.
Async block I/O queue with completion callbacks. Merges adjacent requests.
Parse GPT header and partition entries from block device.
Read and validate ext4 superblock. Extract block size, inode count, features.
Read block group descriptor table. Locate inode/block bitmaps and inode table.
Read inode by number. Parse mode, size, timestamps, extent tree root.
Walk extent tree (leaf and index nodes) to map logical to physical blocks.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: File data blocks located via extents

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse ext4 directory entries (linear and htree). Lookup by name.
Mount ext4 partition as VFS filesystem. Read files and directories.
Cache recently-read blocks in memory. Evict LRU pages under pressure.
Allocate free blocks and inodes from bitmaps for write support.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: New blocks allocated from free bitmap

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Create files, write data, extend/truncate. Update metadata.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: echo hello > file creates file on ext4

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement ordered-mode journaling. Transaction commit, replay on mount.
Boot with root=<partition> and mount ext4 as rootfs instead of initramfs.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Kernel boots with root on ext4 partition

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Write file, reboot, verify file persists. Test mkdir/rm/truncate.
Generate Linux bzImage-compatible kernel image. Parse boot_params from bootloader.
Replace stub APIC with full Local APIC: timer, EOI, spurious vector, ICR.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: APIC timer fires at configured rate

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Program IOAPIC redirection entries. Route IRQs from devices to LAPIC vectors.
Boot application processors via INIT-SIPI-SIPI sequence. AP enters kernel.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: All cores start and run kernel code

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Distribute tasks across CPUs. Per-CPU run queues with load balancing.
Parse ACPI tables for hardware topology, APIC info, power management.
Enumerate PCI bus via ECAM/config space. Map BARs to kernel virtual memory.
Configure MSI/MSI-X for PCI devices instead of legacy IRQs.
NVMe controller init, admin queue, I/O queues, read/write commands.
AHCI HBA init, port detection, SATA read/write via FIS.
Intel e1000 NIC driver. Init, TX/RX descriptors, interrupt handling.
Full PS/2 keyboard driver with scancode set 2, key repeat, LED control.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Keyboard input works on real hardware

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Direct VGA text mode output for pre-framebuffer console.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Text visible on real VGA monitor

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Detect XHCI controller, init, enumerate ports. Stub for future USB device support.
USB keyboard via XHCI. Enumerate device, read HID reports.
Implement ACPI shutdown (S5) and reboot via FADT reset register.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: E820 and UEFI memory map integration
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse E820/UEFI memory map from bootloader. Initialize physical memory allocator from it.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Early printk via serial and VGA
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Kernel log output to both serial port and VGA console during boot.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Boot messages visible on screen and serial

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse kernel cmdline from bootloader (root=, console=, init=, etc.).
Boot Lineluya on physical x86_64 machine. Shell prompt, disk, network.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Boots on real hardware to shell

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Load PT_INTERP, map dynamic linker, resolve shared libraries.
Implement shared file-backed mmap with page cache integration.
Implement FUTEX_WAIT/FUTEX_WAKE for userspace mutexes and condition variables.
Implement clone3 with CLONE_THREAD, CLONE_VM, shared address space threads.
Implement io_uring SQ/CQ rings, IORING_OP_READ/WRITE/ACCEPT/CONNECT.
Implement eBPF bytecode verifier and x86_64 JIT compiler.
Implement BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH/ARRAY and common helpers (bpf_trace_printk, etc.).
Basic DRM/KMS for VESA/EFI framebuffer. Mode setting, dumb buffer, page flip.
ALSA PCM interface stub. Enumerate sound devices, open/write PCM.
Implement /proc/cpuinfo, /proc/meminfo, /proc/stat, /proc/uptime, /proc/version, /proc/filesystems.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: All listed /proc files return valid data

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement /sys/class, /sys/bus, /sys/devices hierarchy for device model.
Auto-create /dev nodes when drivers register devices.
Implement PID namespace isolation. clone(CLONE_NEWPID) creates new PID space.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Process in new PID ns sees PID 1

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement mount namespace (private mounts) and network namespace (private stack).
Implement cgroup v2 hierarchy with cpu, memory, and pids controllers.
Implement seccomp with BPF filter for syscall sandboxing.
Implement ftrace function tracing and kprobes for debugging.
Implement eventfd, timerfd_create/settime, signalfd for epoll integration.
File change notification via inotify. Watch create/delete/modify events.
Boot full Alpine Linux userspace. apk install, networking, multi-user.
Build BusyBox with wasm32-wasi target using wasi-sdk, producing a static WASM binary with core applets (sh, ls, cat, echo, mkdir, rm, cp, mv, grep, sed).
Kernel can parse and load wasm32-wasi ELF/WASM binaries into a WASM runtime instance, setting up linear memory and entry point.
Implement WASI preview1 imports (fd_read, fd_write, fd_close, fd_seek, fd_prestat_get, fd_prestat_dir_name) that route through the kernel syscall layer.
Set up xterm.js v5 in the browser frontend with proper font rendering, ANSI escape code support, and resize handling.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Keyboard input to kernel stdin pipe
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Route xterm.js keyboard events through a message channel to the kernel, delivering keystrokes as bytes to the foreground process stdin.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Keystrokes appear in running WASM process

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Route kernel process stdout and stderr output back to xterm.js for display, preserving ANSI escape sequences.
Implement an in-memory tmpfs filesystem backed by WASM linear memory, supporting files, directories, and basic inode operations.
Virtual filesystem layer that dispatches path operations to the correct underlying filesystem (tmpfs, future OPFS, etc.) based on mount table.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Process table and fork/exec for WASM
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement process management: PID allocation, process table, exec() that instantiates a new WASM module, and waitpid() for process completion.
Implement pipe() syscall with ring buffer, supporting shell pipelines (cmd1 | cmd2) between WASM processes.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Write to pipe[1] readable from pipe[0]

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Pass argc/argv and environment variables to WASM processes via WASI args_get/args_sizes_get and environ_get/environ_sizes_get.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: PATH variable used for command lookup

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Basic signal delivery to WASM processes, allowing Ctrl+C to interrupt running commands and broken pipe detection.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: SIGPIPE on write to closed pipe

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement pseudo-terminal layer with line discipline (raw/cooked modes), supporting job control and terminal escape sequences.
Implement clock_time_get and clock_res_get using performance.now(), plus basic sleep/nanosleep via setTimeout.
Implement random_get using crypto.getRandomValues() for secure random number generation in WASM processes.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: random_get fills buffer with random bytes

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Populate initial rootfs with BusyBox symlinks
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: On kernel boot, populate tmpfs with /bin symlinks to busybox for all applets, /etc with basic config, and /tmp directory.
Implement background process support with job control, allowing & operator, jobs listing, and fg/bg switching.
Support shell I/O redirection operators by manipulating file descriptors before exec, including append mode and stderr redirect.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: echo foo > file writes to file

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: End-to-end tests verifying shell prompt appears, commands execute, output displays, pipes work, and filesystem operations succeed.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: cat > file then cat file roundtrips

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Kernel boot sequence and init process
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement kernel initialization that mounts rootfs, populates /dev, launches /bin/sh as PID 1 init process connected to the xterm.js terminal.
CF Worker that accepts WebSocket connections and proxies them to arbitrary TCP hosts using CF's connect() API, with authentication.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Socket syscall interface (socket, connect, send, recv)
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement BSD socket syscalls in the kernel that create socket file descriptors and route operations to the networking subsystem.
Kernel networking layer bridges socket syscalls to WebSocket connections to the CF proxy, multiplexing multiple TCP connections over WS.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: TCP connect() opens WS to proxy

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement DNS resolution using DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 or Google), callable from getaddrinfo/gethostbyname.
Ensure BusyBox wget works end-to-end by routing HTTP through socket to WS to TCP proxy chain with DNS resolution.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: TLS via rustls compiled to WASM
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Compile rustls to wasm32-wasi to provide TLS 1.3 support, wrapping raw TCP sockets for HTTPS and other secure protocols.
Compile a minimal SSH client (dropbear or similar) to WASM, connecting through the WS-TCP proxy for remote shell access.
Add end-to-end encryption between browser and WS proxy using X25519 key exchange and ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD, independent of TLS.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Key exchange completes on WS open

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: UDP socket support via WS proxy
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Extend the WS proxy and socket layer to support UDP datagrams, needed for DNS direct queries and other UDP protocols.
Implement loopback networking so processes can connect to localhost services without going through the WS proxy.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Server and client on same host work

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement server-side socket syscalls so WASM processes can bind to ports and accept incoming connections on loopback.
Implement select() and poll() syscalls for multiplexing I/O across multiple file descriptors (sockets, pipes, files).
Populate resolv.conf pointing to DoH resolver and hosts file with localhost entry, used by libc name resolution.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Networking integration test: wget URL from browser
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: End-to-end test that boots kernel, launches shell, runs wget to fetch a URL, and verifies the downloaded content.
Implement WS connection pooling to the proxy, automatic reconnection on disconnect, and request queuing during reconnect.
Implement a block device backed by the Origin Private File System (OPFS) API using synchronous access handles in a Worker.
Port or implement ext4 filesystem driver in Rust compiled to WASM, operating on the OPFS block device.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Mount ext4 on OPFS block device

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Fetch a pre-built rootfs image from a CDN/R2 bucket on first boot, caching it locally in OPFS for subsequent boots.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Rootfs image downloaded on first visit
Cached in OPFS for fast reboot

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: NBD client in the kernel that connects to a remote block device server over WebSocket, enabling remote disk access.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Rust server as NBD disk proxy
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Rust server that exposes disk images as NBD over WebSocket, with authentication and optional cloudflared tunnel access.
Fallback block device using IndexedDB for browsers that lack OPFS support, with same block device interface.
Caching layer between filesystem and block device that keeps frequently accessed blocks in memory with async write-back.
Implement fsync/fdatasync syscalls that flush cached blocks to persistent storage, ensuring data durability.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: No data loss on clean close

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Mount the OPFS-backed ext4 filesystem at /home so user data persists across browser sessions.
Query and manage browser storage quota, warning users when nearing limits and preventing silent data loss.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Cloudflared tunnel setup for NBD server
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Configure cloudflared tunnel to expose the Rust NBD server, enabling browser access to remote disks without public IP.
Test that files written to /home persist across page reloads, and that remote NBD mounts work through the proxy.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Write file, reload page, file exists

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Parse X11 protocol messages (CreateWindow, MapWindow, PutImage, PolyFillRectangle, etc.) from byte streams.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Parse all core X11 request types

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: X11 server that accepts connections via Unix domain sockets, manages windows, and dispatches events to clients.
Render X11 window contents to HTML Canvas 2D, supporting PutImage, drawing primitives, and text rendering.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: WebGL rendering backend for OpenGL apps
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Map GLX/OpenGL calls to WebGL for hardware-accelerated rendering of OpenGL-based X11 applications.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Basic OpenGL calls map to WebGL

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Basic window manager that handles window placement, stacking order, resize, move, minimize, maximize, and close.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Drag to move, edges to resize

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Mouse event routing to X11 clients
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Capture browser mouse events and translate them to X11 MotionNotify, ButtonPress, ButtonRelease, and EnterNotify events.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Mouse clicks delivered to correct window

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Keyboard event routing to X11 clients
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Translate browser keyboard events to X11 KeyPress/KeyRelease with proper keycode/keysym mapping and modifier state.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Key events delivered to focused window

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Clipboard integration (X11 selections to Clipboard API)
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Bridge X11 clipboard (PRIMARY, CLIPBOARD selections) with the browser Clipboard API for copy/paste interop.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Copy in X11 app pasteable in browser
Browser copy pasteable in X11 app

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: X11 font server and font rendering
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Serve X11 core fonts and render text using Canvas 2D text APIs or a WASM font rasterizer (FreeType).

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: XTerm X11 terminal emulator in WASM
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Compile xterm (the X11 terminal emulator, not xterm.js) to WASM, connecting to X11 server for graphical terminal.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Compile vi/vim to WASM for X11 terminal
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Cross-compile vim to wasm32-wasi so it can run in the xterm terminal within the X11 environment.
Implement MIT-SHM extension using SharedArrayBuffer for efficient image transfer between X11 clients and server.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: PutImage via SHM faster than copies

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: X11 RENDER extension for anti-aliased rendering
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement the RENDER extension for alpha compositing, anti-aliased text, and gradient fills using Canvas 2D.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Unix domain sockets for X11 connections
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement Unix domain sockets in the kernel for local IPC, used by X11 clients to connect to the X server.
Render X11 cursors (arrow, text, resize, etc.) using CSS cursor or canvas overlay, supporting custom cursor images.
Draw window title bars, borders, close/minimize/maximize buttons with a consistent visual theme.
Handle devicePixelRatio for HiDPI displays and support virtual multi-screen layouts for the X11 server.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Drag and drop between X11 windows
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement XDND (X Drag and Drop) protocol for drag-and-drop between X11 client windows.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: X11 GUI integration test: xterm + vi in canvas
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: End-to-end test launching the X11 server, xterm, and vi, verifying graphical rendering and keyboard input work.
Implement Inter-Client Communication Conventions and Extended Window Manager Hints for proper window management behavior.
Spawn Web Workers representing CPU cores, each capable of running WASM process instances independently.
Use SharedArrayBuffer for kernel shared memory regions accessible from all Web Workers, serving as shared physical memory.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: SAB allocated and shared across Workers

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Implement futex-like synchronization primitives using Atomics.wait() and Atomics.notify() on SharedArrayBuffer.
Scheduler that assigns runnable processes to available Worker CPUs, with load balancing and affinity hints.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Idle Workers pick up runnable tasks

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Kernel-level mutex and semaphore built on futex, used for shared resource protection across Workers.
Insert yield points in long-running WASM execution to prevent Worker monopolization and allow preemption simulation.
Implement System V shared memory syscalls using SharedArrayBuffer regions for inter-process shared memory.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: shmat maps into process address space

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Efficient IPC message passing between Workers using postMessage with Transferable objects and SAB for large data.
Migrate a suspended process from one Worker to another for load balancing, serializing and restoring WASM state.
Run a parallel build (make -j4) using multiple Workers, verifying correct output and speedup over single-threaded.
Desktop environment with a bottom taskbar showing running apps, system tray, and clock built on the X11/WM layer.
Start menu or app launcher that lists installed applications with icons, searchable by name.
Graphical file manager showing directory contents with icons, supporting navigate, open, copy, move, delete operations.
Desktop terminal emulator application (beyond raw xterm) with tabs, configurable fonts, and color schemes.
Run X11 applications on a remote server and display them in the browser via X11 protocol forwarding over WebSocket.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Remote X11 app renders in browser

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Make the desktop installable as a Progressive Web App with offline support via service worker caching.
Route audio output from WASM processes through the Web Audio API, implementing /dev/dsp or ALSA-like interface.
Use the Notifications API to alert users of system events (process completion, errors) when the tab is not focused.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Notifications appear for long-running task completion

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Support configurable desktop wallpaper, window theme colors, and icon theme for visual customization.
Context menus on desktop and in file manager with appropriate actions (new file, paste, properties, etc.).
Settings application for display, audio, network, and storage configuration with persistent preferences.
Simple graphical text editor with syntax highlighting, open/save, and basic editing features beyond vi.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Web browser within the desktop (via iframe or minimal engine)
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Embedded web browser app within the desktop, either via sandboxed iframe or a minimal HTML renderer in WASM.
Global keyboard shortcuts (Alt+F4 close, Alt+Tab switch, Ctrl+Alt+T terminal, Super key for launcher).
End-to-end test of complete desktop: boot, taskbar, launch terminal, open file manager, create file, verify persistence.
Package the Lineluya WASM kernel as a CF Worker that boots on each HTTP request, processing the request as a Linux program.
Map incoming HTTP request (method, headers, body, URL) to environment variables and stdin, CGI-style, for the Linux program.
acceptance_criteria_chirho: HTTP headers available as HTTP_* vars

implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Capture Linux program stdout output and parse it as an HTTP response (status line, headers, body) to return to the client.
Mount Cloudflare R2 object storage as a block device at /dev/sda, enabling filesystem access to R2 buckets.
Expose Cloudflare KV as a virtual filesystem at /proc/kv where keys are filenames and values are file contents.
Expose Cloudflare D1 database as a SQLite-compatible device, allowing standard SQLite queries from Linux programs.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Durable Objects for persistent kernel state
implementation_tasks_chirho.description_chirho: Use CF Durable Objects to maintain kernel state (process table, open files) across requests for stateful workloads.
Cross-compile nginx to WASM so it can run as a Linux program on the edge kernel, serving HTTP requests.

implementation_tasks_chirho.title_chirho: Rust origin proxy server via WebSocket
